physicalNotes: Radius 0.71793227 Jupiter radii from Polanski et al. 2024 (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract): 51,326.4 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius.
